title: Ethiopian Turkey Croustade
description: A flavorful and crispy pastry stuffed with tender turkey and spices, inspired by Ethiopian cuisine.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the cubed dense bread and melted butter, mixing well.
Add the Ethiopian spice blend, salt, and black pepper to the bread mixture, stirring to combine.
In a separate bowl, shred the cooked turkey breast.
Add the shredded turkey to the bread mixture and stir until well combined.
Roll out the croute to a thickness of 1/4 inch (6 mm).
Transfer the croute to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spoon the turkey and bread mixture onto the center of the croute, leaving a 1/2 inch (1 cm) border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the croute with water and fold the edges over the filling to form a triangle.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the croute is golden brown and crispy.
